answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops sybil attacks. A new agent locks 20 POA in escrow until its behavior record, timing, task mix, and counterparties, stays distinct from all others for 30 days. A weekly beacon timestamp marks each check, so a copied fingerprint fails and the escrow stays locked. Forging 1000 identities costs 1000 x 20 = 20000 POA for a month, while an honest agent pays one deposit and unlocks on schedule, whether it sells opal or cuts prism glass.
